description: A researcher is outsourcing annotations and has two options: a specialized third-party or a common third-party annotation company. The specialized company can annotate at a rate of 60 images per hour whereas the common company can annotate at a rate of 40 images per hour. However, the specialized company charges $100 per hour and the common company charges $72 per hour. The researcher has deadlines to meet and must complete a dataset of at least 10,000 images. They also have some special images that only the specialized company can annotate. Therefore, at least a third of work must be allocated to the specialized company. How should the researcher distribute the annotations to the two companies to minimize the cost of annotating the whole dataset?

SpecializedAnnotRate.definition: Annotation rate of the specialized company (images per hour)

CommonAnnotRate.definition: Annotation rate of the common company (images per hour)

SpecializedCostPerHour.definition: Cost per hour of the specialized company

CommonCostPerHour.definition: Cost per hour of the common company

MinTotalImages.definition: Minimum number of images to annotate

MinSpecializedFraction.definition: Minimum fraction of work allocated to the specialized company

objective.description: "Minimize the total cost of annotating the dataset by optimally allocating work between the specialized and common annotation companies"

constraints.description: The total number of images annotated by the specialized and common companies must be at least MinTotalImages
The number of images annotated by the specialized company must be at least MinSpecializedFraction times the total number of images annotated
The number of images annotated by the specialized company must equal SpecializedAnnotRate multiplied by the number of hours hired from the specialized company
The number of images annotated by the common company must equal CommonAnnotRate multiplied by the number of hours hired from the common company
The number of hours hired from the specialized company must be non-negative
The number of hours hired from the common company must be non-negative

SpecializedHours.definition: Number of hours allocated to the specialized annotation company

CommonHours.definition: Number of hours allocated to the common annotation company

SpecializedImages.definition: Total number of images annotated by the specialized company

CommonImages.definition: Total number of images annotated by the common company
